status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_THIS_STAGE (interface-only; the protected runner is a separate, role-scoring stage and is intentionally not built or executed here)
scope_boundary: This stage built ONLY the construction-side analytics (environment lock, baselines, metrics, fixtures, tests, smoke, validator) on SYNTHETIC data. The runner below opens the protected held-out role EXACTLY ONCE after contract lock is authorised; it is out of scope now.

consumes.pinned_snapshot: source_locator_manifest.json (FDSNWS query URL(s), access instant, bytes, sha256) - verified by hash before any parse.
consumes.environment_lock: env_lock.json + requirements.lock.txt - runner must verify via environment.verify_environment(strict=True) and abort on any mismatch.
consumes.frozen_baseline_configs: best_params per baseline id from the construction tuning record (baselines.tune_and_fit output), carried UNCHANGED; the runner performs NO re-tuning on the protected role.
consumes.role_manifest_hashes: role_manifest.json hashes from role_assignment (temporal primary; geographic secondary).
consumes.stage_validation_hash: output_hash_manifest from validation_report.json of this stage.

must_call_interfaces.leakage_audit.audit_feature_names(featur: field-level F1-F4 audit; must pass (100% forbidden rejected, exact clean accepted) before any fit.
must_call_interfaces.leakage_audit.audit_features_against_axi: axis proxy audit; must pass for the axis being evaluated.
must_call_interfaces.leakage_audit.audit_role_manifest(rows,: split-level F5/F6 audit; must pass before scoring.
must_call_interfaces.baselines.assert_fit_allowed(spec, axis): raises LeakageError if the baseline's schema leaks the evaluation axis (e.g. B3_expanded_metadata_logit on temporal/geographic).
must_call_interfaces.baselines.tune_and_fit(spec, constructio: fit ONLY on the construction role.
must_call_interfaces.baselines.predict_proba(fitted, protecte: score the protected role features (source-only, no leaking axis proxy).
must_call_interfaces.metrics.summary(y, p, groups, threshold): Brier (primary), log-loss, AUROC, calibration, confusion at the protocol-fixed threshold; no threshold-selection procedure is executed.
must_call_interfaces.metrics.cluster_bootstrap(y, p, groups,: sequence-cluster CI with the minimum-valid-replicate rule.
must_call_interfaces.metrics.paired_cluster_bootstrap_differe: paired ranking with tie probability and a resolution rule.
must_call_interfaces.metrics.slice_metrics / metrics.threshol: temporal/geographic slices and cdi>=5.5/6/6.5 endpoint-threshold sensitivity.

hard_guarantees_the_runner_must_enforce: Verify pinned snapshot + inventory + role_manifest + env_lock hashes; abort on any mismatch.
Fit every baseline ONLY on the construction role; NEVER fit on protected-role outcomes.
Carry frozen best_params unchanged; perform no hyperparameter selection on the protected role.

Enforce baselines.assert_fit_allowed: B3_expanded_metadata_logit is forbidden on the temporal and geographic transport holdouts (it may appear only on a non-leaking split, as a disclosed proxy-bearing sensitivity).
Issue ONE globally consumed run token; reject event subsets; make retry across output directories impossible.
Derive (not hard-code) any omission/INFEASIBLE status from the metric feasibility states.
Open the protected role EXACTLY ONCE; the role is 'held out from model development with aggregate feasibility previously known', never 'untouched'.
Report the random-vs-event-grouped-vs-sequence-grouped leakage gap as the headline resource output.
